_comment: Example config.json for PES 2017 (t99p17v20). Rename to config.json in the app folder, then adjust the paths. Setup can also write these for you. The /pes17.html write tools work with or without this file as long as save_dir is right.
_save_dir_note: r9: no save folder is hard-coded any more. On first run the app looks for KONAMI\Pro Evolution Soccer 2017\save under your profile, Documents and OneDrive (including localised names like Dokumenti), or you can set it in Classic UI Setup or /pes17.html. The folder must contain ML00000011 (or another ML slot) and EDIT00000000.
_pes17_patch_dir_note: OPTIONAL, offline only. Folder that holds your patch logos: loose PNG/JPG/DDS files named by club name or team id, or CPK archives containing common/render/symbol/flag/e_<teamid>_r.dds. Leave blank to auto-detect download/, Data/, livecpk/, content/ next to pes_exe. The app only READS here; it never modifies the game or patch folder.
_pes17_only_note: PES 2017-only mode. The Classic UI (index.html) is the default landing page at /, and the write/asset tools live at /pes17.html. Wikipedia/flag CDN lookups stay off by default and Google Fonts are removed at build time.
_pes17_allow_writes_note: KEEP FALSE. This only gates the old FL26 write engine, which would corrupt a PES 2017 save. The measured PES 2017 writes are on /pes17.html and are always available.
